name: Terminal Block & Crimp Reference
blurb: terminal blocks and crimp sizes for a wire cross-section
intro: Give a wire size (mm² or AWG) and get the ferrule (DIN 46228-4 colour and pin length), the insulated terminal colour, lugs, and the PCB, DIN-rail and wire-to-board crimp connectors whose rated wire range includes it. Ranges and currents are typical catalogue values (Phoenix Contact, JST, Molex, Anderson): confirm on the part's data sheet.

inputs.label: Wire size
inputs.help: A bare number is mm²; add AWG for gauges.

examples.title: 22 AWG signal wire to a board

usage: Give the wire size as text: a number in mm² (1.5, 0.75 mm²) or a gauge (18 AWG, 2/0). Optionally a category (ferrule, insulated, tube, pcb, din-rail, wire-to-board) and a text filter. It returns the matching ferrule with colour and strip length, the insulated-terminal colour, and a table of parts whose wire range includes the size, with their pitch, range in mm² and AWG, and rated current. Use it when choosing connectors and terminations for a harness or panel.
sources: DIN 46228-4 (ferrule colour code) and Phoenix Contact AI ferrule range
DIN 46235 (tube cable lugs); red/blue/yellow insulated terminal convention (UL 486A-B)
Phoenix Contact catalogue (MPT, MKDS, MSTB, MC, UT/PT terminal blocks)
JST (SH, GH, PH, XH, VH), Molex (PicoBlade, KK 254, Micro-Fit 3.0, Mini-Fit Jr) and Anderson Powerpole data sheets
